summary: Wrote a 6-phase, ~7-hour plan for task 304. Adopts research's chokepoint ruling (fix only in git-commit-scoped.sh's V2 drop pass as a new V9 repository-containment gate) with three argued departures: the predicate resolves the pathspec's PARENT directory and leaves the leaf unresolved (empirically verified -- an in-repo leaf symlink pointing outside the repo is a legal git add argument that research's leaf-resolving form would have wrongly dropped); a new exit code 6 IS required because the observed-damage shape exits 0 post-fix, so research's caller-side branch would never have fired and its both-axes claim would not have held; and exit 7 is reserved for task 336's Containment follow-up instead of 6. One residual is named rather than glossed: D5's status-demotion half is not implementable at the call site, since clamp_mode is consumed ~560 lines before the commit and is monotonic-max by construction.
